answer: Pay each key only what can flow to it through the attestation graph from graders established for ten epochs or more, with every edge capped by the passing grades it actually carries. A farm of a hundred aliases vouching in a ring forms a sealed oasis: dense inside, yet its total income is bounded by the few honest passes it won, so adding keys only slices that income into walnut-sized crumbs. The max-flow is recomputed on-chain each epoch, set in basalt, and edges expire, so no farm can bank a trust path.
